summary: REA-assisted Screen Studio research with read-only Electron/Mach-O inspection, private native-project event counts, and complete video export validation.
audience: Developers and coding-agent operators studying macOS Electron/native recording workflows.
problem: A successful inspection or export-complete log alone does not prove native capture, valid media or working authorization.
differentiator: Explicit evidence levels plus reusable privacy-preserving inspection and full-decode validation tools.
goal: Help readers reproduce file inspections and validate their own licensed recording/export workflow.
